then.text: That was the only page. The rest of the shelves are a disgrace, but they're our disgrace.

else.text: A vellum page? Yes! It came in through the window on the wind and landed in the Classics section. I very nearly catalogued it.
Beautiful hand. There's a note in the margin in Old Irish. I think it says the ink's gone thick and the light is bad. Teachers have been saying that for a thousand years.
{player} tucks the vellum page carefully into the Fieldbook.

{greeting} Portora Royal School, founded under King James I in 1608. Oscar Wilde won a gold medal for Classics here. Samuel Beckett was better at cricket than at French, and then went off to write plays in French. Go figure.
Since 2016 the school has been part of Enniskillen Royal Grammar School. The ghosts of the old boys complain about the paperwork.

en_pupil.text: {greeting} Our English teacher makes us read Waiting for Godot every year. Two men wait for somebody who never comes. It's basically the school bus.
